+import base64
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(source: str) -> bytes | None:
+    """Read inline images or objects from the configured storage bucket."""
+    if not source:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if source.startswith("data:image/"):
+            header, payload = source.split(",", 1)
+            if header.endswith(";base64"):
+                return base64.b64decode(payload)
+            return None
+
+        url = urlsplit(source)
+        key = source
+        if url.scheme or url.netloc:
+            base = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST or "")
+            prefix = base.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+            if (url.scheme not in ("http", "https") or url.scheme != base.scheme
+                    or url.netloc.lower() != base.netloc.lower()
+                    or not url.path.startswith(prefix)):
+                return None
+            key = unquote(url.path[len(prefix):])
+
+        if not key or "\\" in key or any(p in ("", ".", "..") for p in key.split("/")):
+            return None
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        # Missing or malformed images are skipped by export and generation.
+        return None

+import base64
+import io
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+from uuid import uuid4
+from zipfile import ZipFile
+
+import pytest
+from PIL import Image
+
+from app.api.v1.endpoints.episodes import export_episode
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+from app.services.image_source import load_image_bytes
+from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def images():
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (2, 3)).save(buf, format="PNG")
+    png = buf.getvalue()
+    key = storage.upload_image(png, "cuts", "example")
+    inline = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(png).decode()
+    return png, [key, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}", inline]
+
+
+def test_reference_images(images):
+    png, sources = images
+    for source in sources:
+        assert BaseAIService()._download_image(source) == png
+        assert download_image(source).size == (2, 3)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def forbid_http(monkeypatch):
+    def unexpected(*args, **kwargs):
+        pytest.fail("Image loader attempted an HTTP request")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr("requests.sessions.Session.request", unexpected)
+
+
+def test_untrusted_sources_are_skipped(forbid_http, monkeypatch):
+    read = Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, "download_image", read)
+    for source in ("https://untrusted.invalid/image", "//internal.invalid/panel",
+                   f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/%2e%2e/panel", "file:///panel"):
+        assert load_image_bytes(source) is None
+        assert BaseAIService()._download_image(source) is None
+        assert download_image(source) is None
+    read.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def export_sources(sources, fmt):
+    session = Mock()
+    session.get.return_value = SimpleNamespace(title="Panels", deleted_at=None)
+    session.exec.return_value.all.return_value = [
+        SimpleNamespace(cut_order=i, image_path=source)
+        for i, source in enumerate(sources, start=1)
+    ]
+    return export_episode(session=session, episode_id=uuid4(), format=fmt)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_export_reports_missing_cuts(images, forbid_http, fmt):
+    png, sources = images
+    response = export_sources([
+        None, sources[0], "http://internal.invalid/image", "cuts/missing.png",
+        sources[1], "data:image/png;base64,YmFk", sources[2],
+    ], fmt)
+    assert response.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "1,3,4,6"
+    if fmt == "zip":
+        with ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.body)) as archive:
+            panels = ["Panels_02.png", "Panels_05.png", "Panels_07.png"]
+            assert archive.namelist() == [*panels, "missing.txt"]
+            assert archive.read("missing.txt") == b"1\n3\n4\n6\n"
+            assert all(archive.read(name) == png for name in panels)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_complete_export_has_no_missing_report(images, fmt):
+    _, sources = images
+    response = export_sources(sources, fmt)
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in response.headers
+    if fmt == "zip":
+        with ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.body)) as archive:
+            assert "missing.txt" not in archive.namelist()
+
+
+def test_all_missing_exports():
+    from fastapi import HTTPException
+
+    response = export_sources([None, None], "zip")
+    assert response.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "1,2"
+    with ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.body)) as archive:
+        assert archive.namelist() == ["missing.txt"]
+        assert archive.read("missing.txt") == b"1\n2\n"
+
+    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as error:
+        export_sources([None, None], "webtoon")
+    assert error.value.status_code == 400
+    assert error.value.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "1,2"
